comment: The row outputs carry a volt per octave pitch in the DIAT and CHRO modes and a plain 0-12V or 0-1.2V in INF, so the pitch colour describes two of the three modes. The code's comments on the three mode branches name them the other way round: the branch commented diatonic reads the chromatic table and the one commented chromatic reads the diatonic table. The panel labels match what the code does.
